summary: Independently checked all three comparison records against the supplied 30-page PDF, after reading the entire markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-B. Checked the cited outcome, timing, and result pages directly with pymupdf (PDF pp. 8, 10, and 18), together with the design, count, and regression evidence on PDF pp. 1, 7, 9, 13, and 19. The only eligible output-scored outcome is individual DSI creativity change after the collaborative chat. The after_ai, overall_creativity, automated_score, participant, immediate, more_creative, outcome_with_ai=false, and within_person=null codes are supported. The two human-partner comparisons are ai_vs_active, and the persona comparison is ai_design. All estimate statistics and analysis-specific person counts are correctly null, with se_basis=not_reported: the unadjusted creativity finding is an omnibus p > .05 statement, not a pairwise result. The separate OLS creativity model adjusts for agency profiles measured during treatment and is correctly excluded under extraction rule 5; its overall model test cannot supply pairwise statistics. The printed study count of 224 people and cluster counts of 30, 33, and 34 are confirmed; the analyzed count of 224 is explicitly identified as the discourse-clustering sample and is not assigned to the creativity contrasts. The excluded self-reports, perception checks, discourse-process measures, and profile analyses do not supply additional eligible creative-output outcomes. No numerical, coding, scope, or completeness problems were found.
